categories.name: Dried flower
categories.blurb: Dried cannabis flowers, or bud, remain popular for rich aromas, diverse terpene profiles, and varied effects across strains. Seek properly cured buds at our Brampton dispensary to enjoy alone or by adding shatter or resin for a stronger hit.

categories.name: Pre-rolls
categories.blurb: Pre-rolls simplify cannabis use by skipping the rolling step. Choose from various strains, THC levels, or CBD options. Perfect for new users or anyone craving convenience, they’re ready to spark and enjoy right away.

categories.name: Vape
categories.blurb: CBD and THC vaping is discreet and fast-acting. Pens and carts come in diverse strains and potencies to match any preference. They’re ideal for minimal odor, quick hits, and both medical or recreational use.

categories.name: Infused Pre-Rolls
categories.blurb: Infused pre-rolls blend cannabis flowers with shatter or resin for a stronger, more flavorful hit. Added terpenes or fruit notes create a distinctive twist on standard joints, making each session unforgettable for enthusiasts.

categories.name: Concentrates
categories.blurb: For strong effects, concentrates like shatter, resin, wax, and rosin deliver intense hits in small doses. They’re often found at specialized cannabis shops, perfect for dabbing or boosting a joint. Explore classic THC varieties.

categories.name: Edibles
categories.blurb: Edibles now range from brownies to gummies and fruit treats, offering a smoke-free cannabis option. They have a slower onset, so start low and wait. Whether in Brampton or elsewhere, a wide selection is readily available.

categories.name: Accessories
categories.blurb: Quality accessories enhance cannabis sessions. Modern cannabis dispensaries offer portable rolling papers, water bongs, weed grinders and many smoking accessories for a cleaner experience. Whether you prefer shatter flower power or a sleek vape pen, the right gear elevates every puff.

categories.name: Beverages
categories.blurb: Cannabis drinks are cannabis-infused beverages merging the cannabis plant’s benefits with flavors like fruit juices, lemonade, soda, and cola. Infused with THC, THCv, delta-9 THC, or hemp-derived THC products, each cannabis drink offers a consistent dose and refreshing flavor. Drinking THC this way provides an alternative to alcoholic drinks, beer, or other intoxicants.

categories.name: Oil
categories.blurb: Cannabis oil is versatile and convenient for precise dosing. Use it sublingually, in cooking, or in compatible vaporizers. Both medical and recreational formulas often feature different CBD-to-THC ratios. Always store oils properly to preserve potency.

categories.name: Topicals
categories.blurb: Weed topicals let you benefit from cannabis minus psychoactive effects. Cannabis topicals often combine THC, CBD, or CBG to target specific areas. Ideal for gentle relief, topicals are available at our dispensary or by delivery throughout Brampton.

categories.name: Seeds
categories.blurb: Grow your own bud for a personal harvest. Cannabis seeds range from high-THC to CBD-rich. Check local rules first, then enjoy cultivating and sampling fresh flowers. Find seeds in our specialized Ontario cannabis shop!

products.name: Color Cannabis - Mango Haze 3.5g Dried Flower
products.description:
Mango Haze is a Sativa strain, crossed with Northern Lights #5, Skunk, and Haze to create this fruity variety. This specific strain has also been cross-bred with an unknown CBD strain. Mango Haze exhibits a distinctive mango aroma coupled with spicy, sour undertones. The flowers are dark green, resinous and dense with bright orange pistils. Our product is grown locally in Strathroy, Ontario just West of the city of London. Grown in state of the art hybridized, greenhouses, our flowers and tops are dried naturally to preserve the integrity of our plants and hand finished to exact standards.

If you're seeking a vibrant, flavorful, and energizing cannabis strain, the Mango Haze strain is an excellent choice. This sativa-dominant hybrid offers a balanced experience that combines mood-enhancing euphoria with gentle body relief, making it perfect for both recreational users and medical cannabis enthusiasts. Available now at Blaze Cannabis in Brampton, Mango Haze cannabis is beloved for its uplifting effects, rich profile, and tropical, mouth-watering taste.

The Mango Haze cannabis strain is a three-way cross of parent strains Northern Lights #5, Skunk, and Haze. This heritage creates a potent blend of effects that stimulate the mind while relaxing the body, offering balanced effects ideal for daytime use. Whether you're starting a creative project, heading to social gatherings, or simply hoping to improve your mood, Mango Haze delivers a clear, functional high that keeps you uplifted and motivated.

Visually, Mango Haze flowers are stunning, showcasing a green color with vibrant orange hairs and a shimmering coat of trichomes. The tropical aroma bursts with the scent of ripe mangoes, complemented by subtle hints of citrus flavors, spice, and earthy haze. This fruity flavor profile translates into a delicious smoke or vape experience, where the sweet mango notes are layered with a hint of skunk and hints of earthiness.

The psychoactive effects of Mango Haze are known for improving focus, uplifting spirits, and offering relief from stress, mild pain, and mental fatigue. It's a great option for users seeking an energetic but grounded high—especially those looking to avoid the intensity of heavier indicas. Among sativa-dominant strains, Mango Haze stands out for its ability to promote mental clarity while still providing a relaxed body experience.

For cannabis growers, Mango Haze is as rewarding as it is popular. With a moderate flowering time of around 9 to 11 weeks, these plants produce a generous yield of aromatic buds. Known for their terpene-rich composition and well-rounded effects, growers appreciate Mango Haze for its resilience and consistency. It's often ranked among popular strains thanks to this harmony of traits.

Whether you're a seasoned consumer or new to sativa-dominant hybrid strains, Mango Haze offers a standout cannabis experience. With its dynamic lineage, vivid flavor, and feel-good effects, it's no surprise this strain continues to gain popularity among all types of cannabis strains. Visit Blaze Cannabis in Brampton to experience the energizing and flavorful magic of Mango Haze cannabis today.
